notes: Geographic scope for compliance reports. Agents should AskQuestion (multi-select) when needsUserRegions is true. CLI: --regions us,emea or --all-regions.

us.label: United States
us.description: US federal, state, and local law and US cases.

north-america.label: North America
north-america.description: US plus Canada and Mexico (CASL, provincial privacy, Mexico LFPDPPP, etc.).

latam.label: Latin America & Caribbean
latam.description: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, and other LatAm/Caribbean regimes in Part 1.10.8.

emea.label: EMEA
emea.description: EU, UK, EEA, and Middle East/Africa entries in the compendium.

apac.label: Asia-Pacific
apac.description: Australia, Singapore, Japan, Korea, India, and other APAC rows (Part 1.10.9).

all.label: All regions
all.description: No geographic filter — full worldwide compendium themes in evidence-map.
